verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the $5 no-referral commission rule and random allocation to an existing NFT holder.
The client explicitly leaves the first-mint commission destination unresolved because no existing holder is available.
This is a target-specific contract behavior claim covering first-mint and subsequent no-referral commission routing.
This is the first concrete successful-mint test showing that a no-referral commission was not randomly awarded.
The freelancer explicitly claims a target-specific fix for random commission generation after the observed failure.
The client accepts the system-enforced first-mint exception under which no commission is awarded when no prior holder exists.
The unambiguous acceptance resolves the earlier first-mint value uncertainty and returns the Requirement to active status.
This is the first concrete post-fix no-referral mint result indicating through leaderboard totals that the commission was distributed.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Also, regarding the ' Valid referral number' popup:
[ACCOUNT_001] Only NFTs that have already been minted should count as valid.

[ACCOUNT_001] When a code is valid, the message should say: 'Valid referral code! $5 + $500 prize draw ticket to your selected referer.'

[ACCOUNT_001] If there is no code or it is invalid, the message should say: 'No/Invalid referral code! $5 + $500 prize draw ticket to an existing NFT holder at random.'
